report.previous_run_delta: Fresh: Cloudflare added per-Worker roles and account-owned API tokens scoped to individual Workers, plus streaming Workflow instance histories through subscribe() and GET /subscribe. Recovered: OpenAI Agents API, launched September 10, exposes the managed Codex harness in public beta without a separate orchestration fee, but model, tool and sandbox usage remains paid. Yesterday's Bright Data and Browser Run signals remain actionable but unchanged. Vercel OSS is closed; PostHog AI-product credit coverage has ended.
program_surface_results: No new Devin-class startup or founder program suitable for a bootstrapped solo builder survived verification.
Bright Data, Together AI, Deepgram and ElevenLabs remain rolling and unchanged; they were not recycled.
The Devin benchmark now passes on vendor navigation, nested resource pages and launch surfaces, but still needs application-deadline monitoring to avoid late discovery.

signals.approximate_value: No credible cash equivalent; removes custom credential-proxy work and materially reduces blast radius.
signals.cash_required: $0 incremental fee stated; Cloudflare says available to all customers.
signals.catch: Role boundaries do not make agent actions correct. Secrets, bindings and downstream systems still need independent least privilege; Durable Objects inherit Worker scope.
signals.changed: Four per-Worker roles and account-owned API tokens can now be scoped to specified Workers for people, CI and agents.
signals.classification: CONFIRMED FRESH CAPABILITY; AVAILABLE TO ALL CUSTOMERS
signals.eligibility_reality_check: Cloudflare account and an existing Worker required. No startup, funding, incorporation, domain-email, geography or team-size gate.
signals.free_value: Metadata Read-Only, Content Read-Only, Editor and Admin controls at Worker level, with Durable Objects inheriting the implementing Worker's permissions.
signals.immediate_exploit: Create one Metadata Read-Only token scoped to one noncritical Worker, verify that logs work and code/deploy/delete actions fail, then revoke it.
signals.why_asymmetric: An agent can inspect logs without code access, review code without mutation, or deploy without deletion or access to other Workers.

signals.approximate_value: No defensible cash equivalent; replaces polling and bespoke progress/event plumbing.
signals.cash_required: $0 within Workers Free limits. Free limits fail closed when storage is exhausted; Paid usage is metered.
signals.catch: A new long-lived subscription consumes a connection and history contains operational data. Free state is retained three days by default and CPU remains 10 ms per invocation.
signals.changed: WorkflowInstance.subscribe() and GET /subscribe now stream historical and live workflow and step events without polling.
signals.classification: CONFIRMED FRESH CAPABILITY; FREE PLAN INCLUDED WITH LIMITS
signals.eligibility_reality_check: Cloudflare account and Workflow required; no company-stage or application gate.
signals.free_value: The stream includes attempts, sleeps, waits and rollbacks; supports event filters and cursors. Workers Free includes Workflows, 100,000 shared requests/day, 1 GB-month state and 3,000 steps/day.
signals.immediate_exploit: Instrument one tiny synthetic three-step Workflow, subscribe from cursor zero, force one retry, and persist the event sequence in ICE.
signals.why_asymmetric: It provides an event-native spine for B2ROOT checkpoints, live LEVERAGEdelta progress, audit evidence and human-in-the-loop control.

signals.approximate_value: Unquantified labor and infrastructure replacement; the API removes the need to build a durable agent harness, but does not subsidize model or compute usage.
signals.cash_required: Tokens and tools are billed normally. OpenAI-hosted containers start at $0.03 per 1 GB 20-minute session; web search is $10/1,000 calls plus model tokens.
signals.catch: Not zero-dollar in production, public beta may change, hosted sandboxes and tools are separately charged, and a migration only pays if an existing recurring workflow is already valuable.
signals.changed: OpenAI launched the Agents API September 10, exposing the managed Codex harness, long-session compaction, tool search, programmatic tool calling, subagents, tracing and selectable sandboxes.
signals.classification: CONFIRMED FORGOTTEN-SIGNAL RECOVERY; ORCHESTRATION FEE ZERO BUT USAGE PAID
signals.eligibility_reality_check: Public beta is available to all developers in supported API regions with API billing. No startup or funding gate.
signals.free_value: No additional Agents API fee. The open-source harness is inspectable, and self-hosted environments are supported.
signals.immediate_exploit: Run one capped existing task with a self-hosted or 1 GB sandbox, one model, no web search and a $2 project limit; compare completion quality and engineering effort with the current path.
signals.why_asymmetric: It can productize the long-running, tool-using workflow already proven interactively without maintaining context compaction or multi-agent orchestration.
signals.window: Public beta from September 10; no end date.
